text: Now batting, number two, Wisconsin Bratwurst.
Start by adding two pounds of fresh bratwurst sausages and two thinly sliced onions, one
cup of butter, a half teaspoon of ground black pepper, six 12 fluid ounce cans or bottles
Preheat your grill for medium high heat.
Cook for the bratwurst for 20 to 30 minutes or until cooked through.
Add the bratwurst to your lightly oiled grill grate.
Cook the bratwurst on your preheated grill for 10 to 14 minutes, turning occasionally
Enjoy these Wisconsin bratwursts in the bleachers or in your backyard.
They're sure to be a home run.
